title: Bulk discounts and revenue in a stock ledger
prompt:
Add volume discounts and a revenue figure to the program.

1. When a `sell` command sells 10 or more units of an item at once, every unit is sold at a 10 percent discount: the price of one unit is `price * 90 / 100` in whole cents, rounded down. The confirmation line ends with ` (bulk price)`, for example `sold 10 x Pencil for $17.90 (bulk price)`. Selling fewer than 10 units works exactly as before.
2. The shop remembers its revenue: the sum of what customers paid for all completed sales (discounts included; failed sales add nothing). The `report` command prints one more line after `total value=...`: `revenue=$X`, with the amount in the same money format. When the shop has no items `report` still prints only `the shop is empty`, as before.

Everything else must behave as it does now.

cases.name: example
cases.stdin:
add P1 100 199 Pencil
sell P1 3
sell P1 10
report
cases.expected_output:
added P1 (Pencil)
sold 3 x Pencil for $5.97
sold 10 x Pencil for $17.90 (bulk price)
P1 Pencil qty=87 price=$1.99 value=$173.13
total value=$173.13
revenue=$23.87
